Choose Aegean, Europe's Best Regional Airline, and discover why customers come back to us time after time.
Passengers that need more flexibility and free baggage allowance when planning their journey and do not want to pay rebooking fees, now they can do unlimited changes. Also included are:
- 1 free checked baggage allowance (23kgs) - cabin baggage: 1 item up to 8kg and 1 personal item women's/men's handbag or a thin laptop case - Cold meal, hot & cold beverages, beer & wine - Unlimited free ticket changes (No rebooking fee. • Please note that if the flight is operated by another airline then the onboard product service may be different to that described above.
